author: Yffe
content:
Failing tests pinned at forge/tests/divergence_effect_link_string_wrappers.rs::{print_wrapper_builds_and_runs, read_line_wrapper_builds} (both #[ignore]d, blocker #82).

AUTHORITY: .design/basis/08-runnable-effect-link.md REQ-1 ("os::write/os::print (std::io::stdout().write_all, Stage 7 String arg) … os::read_line (… over Stage 7 String). Each wrapper's signature MATCHES the #[boundary] primitive it backs") + REQ-3 ("COMPILES + RUNS + does real I/O"). The wrapper-set table enumerates os::write/os::print/os::read_line as v1 wrappers.

TOOLCHAIN: forge/src/effect_wrappers.rs WRAPPERS emits the print/write/read_line bodies referencing `super::TString` (e.g. `pub fn print(s: super::TString) -> u64`, `super::TString { data: s.into_bytes() }`). thermite-lower/src/l1.rs lower_type arm `Type::String => Ok("TString")` lowers a String-typed boundary signature to the bare name TString. But neither emit_mod_os nor lower_l1 emits a `struct TString` definition into the BUILD-emitted crate (the struct lives only in the L3/Verus lowering, thermite-lower/src/lower.rs).

REPRO (live, real rustc): forge build print_demo.th --entry greet → error[E0425]: cannot find type `TString` in module `super` + error[E0425]: cannot find type `TString` in this scope. read_line identical (+ E0422 on the struct literal).

IMPACT: 3 of the 5 wrappers REQ-1 enumerates (Write family + read_line) do NOT compile/run via forge build. REQ-1/REQ-3 are NOT-STARTED for those families, contradicting the REQ-status "SHIPPED". Only os::now + os::read_byte (u64-only) actually link+run. Root cause in the owning crates: forge/src/effect_wrappers.rs (the wrapper type) and/or thermite-lower/src/l1.rs (the build crate must define/emit a resolvable String type).
